group_mapping_policy: 27 source groups retain all exact spec/paper/claim/contract/oracle references from P9-1.1; module ownership is a downstream planning refinement, not a rewrite of that record.
dependency_policy: Module dependencies name interfaces, not mandatory eager imports of unimplemented siblings. Generic modules never depend on GRC9V4 modules. The step registry binds only available candidate evaluators; unavailable A/realizations must not block C_OS imports.
legacy_binding_policy: Explicit baseline-revision members, not a wildcard ban on future files or an implementation authorization. Two integration targets require later additive-diff review; other bound targets remain unchanged for V4 work.
external_legacy_delegate: src/pygrc/models/grc_9_v3.py (unchanged; referenced only by the V4 disabled-compatibility adapter)

dependency_review.role: Dense binary64 backend through V4-owned adapters; explicitly declare in an optional V4 extra before runtime, do not rely on matplotlib transitively.
Proposed V4 JCS dependency, gated by frozen preimages plus independent Unicode/number edge vectors; never substitute legacy json.dumps or the fixture generator.
Proposed Draft 2020-12 wire/strict validation adapter; semantic admission remains separate V4 logic.
No initial dependency; later realization solver/evaluator needs require explicit review.

oracle_policy.expected_values: Frozen published bytes/results or separately reviewed hand-derived/rational/scalar reference computations; do not call production solvers/serializers/allocators to calculate their own expected values.
oracle_policy.reuse_boundary: Frozen vector data may be read, not imported as algorithms. Runtime results are separate evidence. A and C, each realization and each compatibility surface remain independent test scopes.

retention_policy.large_artifacts: External content-addressed blobs allowed only with hashes and reproducible retrieval; run manifest retained in repo. Never overwrite frozen fixture/vector bytes.
retention_policy.failed_runs: Retain failures, rejected operations, seeds and gate holds; do not replace with passing reruns.

observations.meaning: 152 D10.2 contract API indeterminate support semantics preserved; accepted spec remains primary implementation source.

Legacy nominal GRCState/StepResult annotations conflict statically with V4 standalone immutable records; local structural protocols and narrowly justified override typing boundaries only, never mutable inheritance or false runtime casts.
Legacy canonical serialization is not V4 JCS; legacy capability registry/test remains exactly four families. V4 uses its own exact-profile registry, not a global legacy registry mutation.

implementation_follow_through.requirement: Load versioned release-bound schema/identity assets from the installed distribution without ambient checkout, mutable remote schemas or vector-builder imports.

packaging_plan.loader: importlib.resources.files with byte verification before parsing; no cwd or repository-root fallback
packaging_plan.index: Package-local versioned asset-index.json binds copied filenames, accepted release ID and SHA-256 values; repository paths in the release manifest are provenance, not installed lookup paths.
packaging_plan.integration: pyproject.toml package-data declaration through the already proposed additive integration; new asset files require later P9-G1 mutation authority.

V4 imports and requests with extra

Decide graph storage/lookup and utilities explicitly; no target reuse percentage or similarity-only shared refactor.

implementation_follow_through.requirement: Start with deliberately distinct live and reset states before migration or affine event. Independently check both mapped/reconstructed targets, persistent ledger, operation receipt delta and reset after the operation. Identical inputs cannot prove both were transformed.

Reset-only target failure holds the whole operation atomic even if current target admits
Full payload and both digest comparisons on rejection; ledger versus emitted delta kept separate

successor_verification_follow_through.requirement: Green review with runtime_authorized=false never permits src/, tests/ or dependency edits.
Legitimate planning additions use successor state while historical release audits retain their own unchanged assertions.
Missing required lifecycle child, forged evidence alias or unresolved dependency holds affected gate even if counts match.
Unimplemented A/PC/RG2b does not block C_OS, but unexecuted exact identities cannot be advertised from the planned roster.
Optional completion is neither a universal prerequisite nor advertisable without its own scoped evidence.
